rows.Kwic: 參禪學道是汝本分事、喫粥喫飯是汝本分事、屙屎撒尿是汝本分事、行坐打眠是汝本分事

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi (百癡禪師語錄): Baichi Yuan, in his own informal address, lists studying Chan, eating gruel and rice, bodily functions, and ordinary movement as the listeners' own fundamental matter.

rows.Kwic: 邯鄲一枕，歷盡榮華五十載，覺來黃粱炊尚未熟

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi (百癡禪師語錄): Baichi Yuan, in his inscription on the Record of Lu Sheng's Yellow-Millet Dream (題盧生黃粱夢記), recounts the Handan pillow dream and says that Lu Sheng awoke before the millet was cooked.
